Plot simulation results

Source: R/results.R
plot.sim_result.Rd

Draws one panel per signal against time with base graphics. Signals produced by discrete blocks are drawn as steps (held between sample hits); continuous signals as lines. Event times are marked with dotted vertical lines. By default the inputs of scope blocks are shown, or, without scopes, the outputs of continuous and discrete dynamic blocks.

# S3 method for class 'sim_result'
plot(x, signals = NULL, events = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

A sim_result.

signals

Signal names to plot.

events

Mark event times.

...

Passed to graphics::plot().

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

m <- sim_model()
sim_add_block(m, "sine", "u")
sim_add_block(m, "zero_order_hold", "zoh", period = 0.5)
sim_connect(m, "u", "zoh")
r <- sim_run(sim_compile(m), c(0, 6))
plot(r, c("u", "zoh"))
